dashboard.subtitle: Approvals, payouts, and audit.
dashboard.emptyTitle: Operator tools are on the way
dashboard.emptyBody: Licence reviews are ready. Payouts and the audit trail arrive with the operator console.

partners.title: Licence reviews
partners.description: Check each licence against the Ordem before an expert is listed.
partners.emptyBody: New licences and listed experts who still need a check will show up here.

detail.listedNote: This expert is listed. They stay listed while you review, and rejecting removes them from public listings.
detail.noApplication: This expert has not sent a licence yet. They see a prompt on their dashboard. You can decide once they send it.
detail.rejectedNote: This application was rejected. The expert can send their details again.

checklist.register_checked: Licence found and active in the Ordem's public register
checklist.name_matches: Name on the register matches this expert
checklist.ers_checked: ERS registration number confirmed with the ERS

detail.reasonHelp: The expert reads this in their email.

errors.validation: Check the form and try again.
errors.changed: The expert sent new details. Reload to see them.
errors.self: You cannot review your own application.
errors.forbidden: You do not have access to this review.
errors.failed: That did not work. Please try again.
errors.step-up: You signed in more than 12 hours ago. Sign out and sign in again, then decide. Copy your reason first if you wrote one: this page will not keep it.

queue.range: Showing {from, number} to {to, number} of {total, number}
queue.end: You've reached the end of the queue.

clinics.title: Clinic verifications
clinics.description: Check each clinic's legal name and NIF against the public register before it is shown as verified.
clinics.emptyBody: When a clinic sends its legal name and NIF, it shows up here.

detail.verifiedNote: This clinic is verified under another filing and stays verified whatever happens to this one.

checklist.legal_entity_checked: Legal name found in the public register, and the company is active
checklist.tax_id_checked: NIF or VAT number belongs to that company

detail.reasonHelp: Ask for changes when the clinic can correct a detail; reject when the company cannot be confirmed. Eleva emails your reason to the clinic's owner and admins and shows it on the clinic's Verification page, so write it for the clinic: about the company, without names, emails or phone numbers.

errors.validation: Check the form and try again. A reason cannot contain an email address.
errors.changed: The clinic sent new details. Reload to see them.
errors.decided: Someone already decided this filing. Reload to see the decision.
errors.self: You cannot review a clinic you belong to. Ask another reviewer.
errors.forbidden: You do not have access to this review.
errors.failed: That did not work. Please try again.
errors.step-up: You signed in more than 12 hours ago. Sign out and sign in again, then decide. Copy your reason first if you wrote one: this page will not keep it.

notes.approved: This filing is approved: the clinic is verified. Eleva tells the clinic's owner and admins by email.
notes.needs_changes: You asked for changes. Eleva tells the clinic's owner and admins by email, with your reason. When the clinic sends its details again, this filing comes back as “To check”.
notes.rejected: This filing was rejected. Eleva tells the clinic's owner and admins by email, with your reason. The clinic can send its details again.

detail.people: {people, plural, one {# person in the clinic} other {# people in the clinic}}

rejectConfirm.title: Reject this filing?
rejectConfirm.body: Eleva emails the clinic's owner and admins that these details could not be verified, with your reason. The clinic can send its details again.
rejectConfirm.reason: Your reason, as the clinic will read it

staffEntry.title: Enter the staff console
staffEntry.body: Here you can see members' and experts' data across Eleva. What you open and what you change are recorded in the audit log.
staffEntry.error: We couldn't open the staff console. Try again in a moment.
